description: Merge system extension images into /usr/ and /opt/.

next.name: merge
tip: Merge extensions into the relevant hierarchies.

next.name: refresh
tip: Unmerge and merge the extensions again.

next.name: status
tip: Show the current merge status (the default).

next.name: unmerge
tip: Unmerge extensions from the relevant hierarchies.

option.name: --image-policy
tip: Specify the disk image dissection policy.

option.name: --mutable
tip: Specify a mutability mode of the merged hierarchy.
Possible values: yes, no, auto, import, ephemeral, ephemeral-import

option.name: --no-legend
tip: Do not show the headers and footers.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --no-reload
tip: Do not reload the service manager.

option.name: --noexec
tip: Whether to mount the extension overlay with noexec.

option.name: --root
tip: Operate relative to this root path.
